artworks.title: C'est bien agréable de jardiner
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two characters in casual or rural outdoor attire standing together in a garden setting. The person on the left has long, curly hair and hands in their pockets, while the person on the right is bent forward holding a hat and a shovel stuck in the ground. Both characters have exaggerated and simplistic facial features, depicted in a cartoonish style. The background features line drawings of plants and bushes, and there is text visible at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Une journée de pluie
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cartoonish scene at a billiards table. Two exaggerated figures are depicted: one is perched atop the billiard table, reaching out towards a cue ball, with a highly animated expression; the other stands beside the table, holding a cue stick and a pipe, with a bemused look. The setting appears to be an interior space containing the billiard table, including a decorated wall in the background.

artworks.title: L'accordéon, dit soufflet à musique
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three main figures with exaggerated features. The central character is holding an accordion, standing with their body fully visible, slightly bent, and wearing a cap and a dark suit. Their face is turned towards the person leaning against a table, showcasing prominent facial features such as an elongated chin and large nose, with short, curly hair peeking from under the cap. The second person is standing with their back and head turned toward the viewer, leaning with both elbows on a tall table or counter. They have a slim build, a long tailcoat, and dark, slicked-back hair. In the background, there are faint outlines of two other figures sitting at a table. The setting is a dimly lit interior environment, possibly a bar or a café, with lightly decorated walls.

artworks.title: Plus qu'un point! ... Pas de chance!!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two individuals are shown around a billiard table with cues in hand. One man is elderly with exaggerated features and a hat, while the other has prominent features, dark hair, and a formal suit. Behind them are figures up to their chests, wearing various hats. The background is a simple, textured wall.

artworks.title: Voisin, êtes-vous comme moi? ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: There are two men in the image. The first man is shown from the waist up behind a barrier that looks like branches or shrubs. He is hunched over with crossed arms, wearing a cap. The second man is shown from head to toe, wearing a long coat and a hat like the first man's, with his hands in his pockets and looking at the first man. The background shows a wintry landscape with bare branches and shrubs, creating an outdoor rural winter scene. The figures and scene are sketched in a monochromatic style.

artworks.title: On nous avait dit de venir dans ce pays ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the waist up, positioned facing each other in a forest setting. Both men are standing upright, with one of them holding a long stick on his shoulder and the other resting it against the ground. The man on the left has a thick mustache that covers his upper lip and wears a wide-brimmed hat, while the man on the right has a beard and wears a hat with a shorter brim. Both men are dressed in heavy coats suitable for cooler weather. The man on the left has a sack slung over his shoulder. The background is a forest with tall, leafless trees creating a stark landscape. No jewelry or additional objects are visible, aside from the sticks and bags they have.

artworks.title: Un réveil en sursaut
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a bed, startled awake. It is titled "UN REVEIL EN SURSAUT." The drawing shows two figures, sitting upright in bed amidst draped curtains. One figure is wearing a nightcap and both appear startled. They are in a dimly-lit room with a candle on a bedside table casting shadows. The drawing's lines are fluid yet defined, giving a detailed quality to the image.

artworks.title: Cette année encore des vénus ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in an art gallery, observing the artworks on display. The scene is depicted from a mid-length perspective, showing most of the people's upper bodies. Two central figures, presumably women, are positioned in the foreground. They are depicted in profile, leaning slightly toward each other as they converse, their hands gesturing expressively. The woman on the left has an exaggerated, distressed expression and tousled hair peeking out from her bonnet, while the woman on the right has a calmer demeanor with her hair neatly tucked under a bonnet. Both women are clad in heavy, layered clothing typical of the era, including shawls and long-sleeved garments. They are surrounded by other onlookers, mostly men in top hats, who are tightly packed in the art gallery setting. The background features large paintings on the wall, with one prominently displaying a sketchy outline of a nude figure, possibly a Venus, and another painting partially visible beside it. The interior setting is bustling with patrons, creating a lively and crowded atmosphere.

artworks.title: Dis donc, mon homme, s'ils savaient ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an exhibition entrance labeled "Exposition Fromages Volailles" with several figures gathered in a queue. The drawing shows individuals lining up outside an entrance, eagerly waiting for entry to the exhibition. An assembly of people stand in line outside the entrance, with two figures observing the queue. The style of the drawing includes detailed attention to caricature. The shading and line work effectively convey texture and expression, capturing a moment of social observation with a hint of humor.

artworks.title: Le prèvenu
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the waist up, seated side by side. The man on the left is facing forward, seated with a pen in his hand poised over a sheet of paper on a desk. He has a serious facial expression and is wearing glasses, with short hair partly covered by a traditional barrister's wig. His clothing is a legal robe. The man on the right is leaning toward the legal professional, turning his head slightly to speak. He has a long face and disheveled hair, wearing a casual jacket and an open shirt. His hand is raised in a gesture, and there is a hat or cap on the table in front of him. Behind them is a courtroom setting with an audience of sketchy figures looking forward, set against a wooden backdrop with architectural detailing.

artworks.title: La toile!!!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an audience in a theater setting. In the drawing, a group of people with exaggerated facial expressions and pointed hats are sitting in what appears to be a theater. They are shown in a state of animated discussion or debate. The text "THEATRE DE LA GUERRE" is visible on a draped curtain. The style of the drawing is characterized by detailed line work and dynamic positioning of figures. The figures appear gesturing and leaning.

artworks.title: Dire que peut-être j'en serai réduit ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in a bent posture, leaning forward while holding a top hat in both hands. The person has prominent facial features with a strong jawline and a mustache. Their hair is styled in an updo with a crown on top. They are wearing a dark ensemble with a detailed top, flowing sleeves, knee-high boots, and a sword on their belt. The background shows sketchings on the wall and a draped fabric to the right.

artworks.title: The Nile—Evening
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1913)

artworks.title: Fort St. lago, Madeira
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Edward M. East, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with a village or fortified structure near a rocky cliffside. In the background, there is a calm sea with small rock formations at the horizon. The sky is filled with soft clouds, and the color palette consists of earth tones and blues. In the foreground, there is a wooden fence leading towards the water. The brushstrokes give a watercolor quality to the scene.

artworks.title: Design for a Monument in Memory of George B. Doane
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a monument in an obelisk style with a square base and a tall tapering pillar ending in a pyramidal top. The material is depicted as a light-colored stone. There is an inscription on the front of the base dedicating the monument to George S. D. Dane, M.D., with his birth and death dates. Above the inscription, there is a decorative relief showing a seated figure. The scale of the monument appears imposing in comparison to human proportions.

artworks.title: Camp
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1959)
artworks.description: The image is a detailed monochromatic depiction of a serene forest clearing viewed from a slightly elevated angle. Various elements such as trees, a hammock, a horse, a wagon, and a person can be seen within the scene. The background shows a faint treeline, suggesting an open space beyond the forest. The drawing uses precise, delicate brushstrokes to outline each element with meticulous attention to detail. The overall atmosphere of the scene is quiet and calm.

artworks.title: Mr. Way and Mr. Booth
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1959)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two men. One man is standing with his hands in his pockets. He has an angular face, wears a top hat, a coat with tails, a waistcoat, and trousers. The other man is seated on a bench, partially facing the viewer. He has a rounded face with a beard and a mustache, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a jacket, trousers, and shoes. The background is minimalistic with faint outlines indicating landscape features like hills or fields and some sketchy foliage at the base. Handwritten identifiers are present around the image, likely names and a date.

artworks.title: Gestin
artworks.medium: graphite and wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of trees with arching branches. The horizon is not visible, suggesting a forested area. The trees are depicted with pencil-like strokes, creating a textured look. The color palette is mainly gray. Some rocks and a stream are visible, adding to the natural setting.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: This drawing shows a landscape with a path leading into a cluster of trees scattered across a gentle slope, some forming a small grove to the right and a few standing isolated to the left. The drawing is done in a sketchy style in shades of gray and black against the off-white background. Lightly sketched lines indicate grasses and shadows surrounding the path, transitioning into denser tones in the distance.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper body portrait of a man facing the viewer straight on. He has strong facial features such as a jawline, brow ridge, and light-colored eyes. His dark brown hair is slightly wavy, brushed back, with some strands falling. The man is wearing a dark garment with a high collar and visible layers underneath. The background shows incomplete watercolor elements and artistic brushstrokes on the right edge. There is also neutral wash of colors, and handwritten text at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: This image depicts a person with wavy hair in a high-collared garment. The individual is shown facing forward with their eyes closed and head slightly tilted downwards. The facial features are softly shaded, showing a defined nose and closed lips. The background is plain.

artworks.title: John Cheney
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: This image is a sketch showing the head and upper shoulders of a person. The person is facing forward with a slightly downcast head. The facial features include a softly rounded face with closed eyes or eyes looking downward, a straight nose, and a relaxed mouth. The hair is medium-length and tousled, framing the face. The clothing sketched suggests a high-collared coat and a necktie or cravat. The background is a plain, unadorned surface. The entire image has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Ventre affamé n'a pas d'orleilles
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals behind a window. The person on the left is leaning forward, with balding hair and an elongated face. The person on the right stands upright, holding a plate. Both wear dark clothing. Outside the window are shutters. Below, there are three figures. On the left, a person with long, tied-back hair plays a stringed instrument. In the center, a figure wearing a tall hat appears to be singing. On the right, another person wearing a top hat plays a flute. They are wearing layered clothes of the era and are in front of a wall sign. The background is a lightly textured backdrop, and the foreground suggests a street setting.

artworks.title: Landscape with Mill
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a rural landscape with a tall, cylindrical tower on a hill. The horizon is low, with the land gently sloping downwards on the right. A large rock or boulder is near the tower. The sketch is monochromatic, using shades of gray to depict the scene. The background is empty, highlighting the solitude of the landscape and the windmill structure.
